title: Origami Crane: the concept's head and neck, measured

ref.what: The body, breast to where the tail starts (everything else is a share of this)

lines.what: Head: top of the head to where the beak starts
Neck, first stroke: out from the breast, almost level
Neck, second stroke: folds back up (its near top edge)
Neck height where it leaves the breast
Second stroke: height of the strip
Head: half its width (the far half of its top, seen from above)

notes: The picture is a three-quarter view from the front-left, about 25 degrees above. Numbers are good to about one part in ten.
At these sizes the neck and head reach about one body length ahead of the breast: about 2 studs past the starter plane's nose.
